crossRefs.note: For your livestock also, and for the animals that are in your land, shall all its increase be for food.

translations.web: For your livestock also, and for the animals that are in your land, shall all its increase be for food.
translations.bsb: and for your livestock and the wild animals in your land. All its growth may serve as food.
translations.kjv: And for thy cattle, and for the beast that are in thy land, shall all the increase thereof be meat.
translations.asv: And for thy cattle, and for the beasts that are in thy land, shall all the increase thereof be for food.
